'''Energy walls''' were three [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall portable [[Force field/Legends|force fields]]. Made of energy, they carried a powerful electrical charge that shocked and repelled anyone who touched it or attempted to climb over it. Energy walls were deployed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They were used to create temporary [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] that the population were placed into once they were arrested during the invasion.<ref name="Invasion" />
